paper.title: Multimodal Web Navigation with Instruction-Finetuned Foundation Models
paper.central_claim: Recasting web navigation as multimodal question answering, jointly finetuning instruction-tuned foundation models with temporal/local screenshot tokens and large-scale agent demonstrations, improves grounded perception, HTML comprehension and multi-step reasoning; WebGUM surpasses prior offline/online systems and humans on MiniWoB++, improves WebShop, and transfers strongly to real-world action prediction.

signatures.object: Web task/state/action representation and offline policy
signatures.information: Privileged HTML plus instruction/action history and two160×160 screenshots padded224×224; local16×16 ViT patches; selector integer targets.
signatures.operation: ViT-B16 encodes392 temporal/local visual tokens; concatenate in T5 encoder with text; jointly finetune Flan-T5/ViT; autoregressively emit textual click/type(selector,text).
signatures.output: One executable action in constrained structural space.
signatures.conditions: HTML IDs expose all needed targets; pretrained representation and corpus cover actions; screenshots aligned with states; limited action vocabulary sufficient.
signatures.feedback: No online gradient updates at evaluation; fresh observed page after action and environment terminal success.
signatures.selection_rule: Supervised next-action prediction on retained demonstrations; no best-of-N inference selection.
signatures.data: 401k MiniWoB trajectories, including347k agent successes and54k Synapse/PaLM2 supplement, plus book-flight script.
signatures.persistence: Offline updated parameters; two-frame temporal context is not persistent cross-task memory.
signatures.later_use: MiniWoB heldout instances, new known-primitive compositions and HTML perturbations; Mind2Web requires additional training; WebShop separately finetuned text-only.
signatures.claimed_effect: Borrow foundation-model priors while retaining local/temporal vision and simplify bespoke control architecture.
signatures.failure_boundary: HTML dependence; restricted click/type; tiny-image regime; long-horizon memory and repeated layouts; no real-site autonomous deployment.

signatures.object: Agent-generated demonstration corpus and success filtering
signatures.information: MiniWoB task instructions, full HTML/screenshots/actions, programmatic outcome reward; teacher policy and private-model traces.
signatures.operation: Rollout existing WebN-T5, retain2.8k successes; fit Flan-T5-XL; rollout10k per task and retain347k; supplement54k private teacher episodes and scripted book-flight policy; offline behavior cloning.
signatures.output: 401k training trajectories and trained policy;347k public subset.
signatures.conditions: Known tasks supply reliable executable reward; teacher succeeds often enough; private supplement and scripted policy remain part of full-data evidence.
signatures.feedback: Environment terminal reward selects trajectories; no learned judge filtering.
signatures.selection_rule: Keep successful MiniWoB trajectories; tune WebShop separately with human-demo score≥50,840episodes.
signatures.data: Collection per-task counts and source mix disclosed; no isolation of teacher quality versus recipe/data amount.
signatures.persistence: Corpus and trained model parameters; not an autonomous retained-edit/skill-learning loop.
signatures.later_use: Student evaluation on same task families; downstream Mind2Web further finetuning.
signatures.claimed_effect: Scale multimodal behavior support more cheaply than millions of human demonstrations.
signatures.failure_boundary: Construction and benchmark task families overlap; failed/excluded teacher data not equally tested; total multi-stage collection cost unreported;54k private supplement not included in released347k.

claims.text: Offline multimodal WebGUM reaches94.2%, exceeds prior offline48.4%, online-RL and humans.
claims.setting: Flan-T5-XL+ViT-B16,401k agent/teacher trajectories,56MiniWoB task families,HTML+screenshots;100episodes each.
claims.control: Within-recipe HTML/image/token/data/model controls; cross-paper headline baselines differ in task sets,training data,backbones,action permissions and timing.
claims.selection_vs_test: Collection on same task families; new episode instances for testing; one training seed; some tasks removed; time limit ignored.
claims.result: 94.2 vs48.4 is45.8percentage points, not relative45.8%; HTML-only88.7.
claims.denominator: 56×100=5600evaluation episodes; baseline aggregate denominators not identical.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Strong author-reported recipe and modality gain on chosen MiniWoB subset, not a controlled proof of superiority to humans/all prior agents.

claims.text: Local/temporal perception and instruction-finetuned priors explain improved comprehension and multi-step reasoning.
claims.setting: Base/XL student ablations; WebSRC answer-containing snippets; WebShop text-only downstream.
claims.baseline: HTML-only,white/random screenshots,local-only/temporal-only tokens; T5 and different model sizes; published ReAct/WebN.
claims.control: Several informative controls, but instruction tuning changes multiple abilities; random images may reveal same-task cues; no unique reasoning intervention.
claims.selection_vs_test: 347kBase ablations;840WebShop demos selected byscore≥50; threshold test/validation separation not explicit;500test instructions.
claims.result: Local+temporal66.1 vs64.2/64.0; correct visual94.2 vs90.9white/92.2random; WebShop45% vs40%publishedReAct.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Visual token construction and instruction-tuned recipe improve measured performance; reasoning as the unique causal prior is not established.

claims.text: Strong positive transfer to real-world action prediction.
claims.setting: MiniWoB-pretrained source then further finetuned on Mind2Web training data; top50HTML candidates; original cross-task/site/domain offline splits.
claims.baseline: Same-size MindAct-XL usingFlan-T5, plusGPT-4ICL with different supervision/budget.
claims.control: Same backbone family/target benchmark; no live autonomous runs or zero-target-training result.
claims.selection_vs_test: Mind2Web formal heldout site/domain splits; ground-truth action history for each independently evaluated step; construction includes target training but not split-heldout sites/domains.
claims.denominator: Original splits252cross-task/177cross-website/912cross-domain tasks; metrics from fixed source protocol, not executed recovery-capable episodes.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Modest positive offline transfer after target finetuning; no online unseen-site transfer, no zero-shot real-web capability and no single checkpoint across platform families.

readable_rationale: 配方和大量消融是实质贡献：共享 T5 表征、两帧局部视觉 token、指令微调与成功轨迹扩充，使离线训练策略取得高 MiniWoB 成功率。94.2 对48.4是45.8个百分点，不是孤立某一机制的提升；基线任务集与限时协议不同，不能直接证明超人。Mind2Web 的正迁移是额外目标训练后的 teacher-forced 离线预测，不是在线真实网站迁移。单种子、推理因果解释和阈值选择仍弱。
